title: Node0 Genesis Asset Manifest v1
description: Schema for declaring Node0 founder-seed assets prior to public hash verification. Each asset entry MUST declare its visibility and proof_status; the manifest script (tools/node0_genesis_manifest.py) honors visibility when computing hashes.

node_id.description: Canonical Node0 reference, e.g. BIZRA-641A1D00 / Mumo / 369319cd…676a per project_node0_sovereign_origin_sealed memory.

hash_algorithm.description: BLAKE3 preferred; SHA-256 only as fallback.

previous_manifest_hash.description: Hex of the prior manifest's BLAKE3 hash for chain continuity. Null on the first manifest.

asset_id.description: Stable identifier within the manifest. Must not change across regenerations.

title.description: Human-readable label. May be in any language. Used in reports; never hashed as content.

language.description: BCP-47 tag, e.g. ar, en. Optional.

created_at_claim.description: Free-form date-of-origin claim, e.g. 'Ramadan 2023'. Subject to FOUNDER_STATED until anchored.

current_location.description: Human-readable hint of where the asset lives. Avoid leaking absolute paths to private archives.

path_relative.description: If the asset is in-tree, repo-relative path. Null for private/redacted assets.

visibility.description: Controls what the manifest script does. 'public' hashes content openly; 'private' hashes content but does NOT include the bytes anywhere; 'hash_only' identical to 'private' (alias); 'redacted' skips entirely with reason.

proof_status.description: Truth label per BIZRA claim discipline. VERIFIED requires hash + verifiable origin; FOUNDER_STATED is unverified founder testimony; PLANNED is not yet present.

redaction_reason.description: Required when visibility=='redacted'. Brief, non-leaking explanation.

size_bytes.description: Computed by the manifest script for resolvable assets. Do not hand-edit.

content_hash.description: Hex-encoded BLAKE3 (or SHA-256) of the file bytes. Computed by script; do not hand-edit.

metadata_hash.description: Hash of (path||size||proof_status||visibility||created_at_claim) — always computable, even for redacted assets, because no raw content is involved.

poi_relevance.description: Why this asset matters to Node0 genesis. Free text.

risk_notes.description: Privacy/security/legal flags for this asset. e.g. 'contains personal medical context — keep redacted forever'.
